sentences.text: I am glad.

Cut a strip.

Shut the shop.
The rich man can chat.
I had lunch on the bench.
A thin cat is on the path.

This is my bag.
That man can bathe.
The white whale is big.
When can I spin the wheel?

Say the phrase.
Catch the ball.
